notes: Variant WLC.JOS.15.63.v004 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base, covering s008; the retained reading is among those the ASV permits, so rule 53 does not apply.

s002 gives as for to the object marker on the fronted object: by rule 16's subtraction nothing but the object relation is lost, and no other morpheme licenses the words. The competing reading marks the marker unrepresented and as for added, which rule 30 disfavours. s018 is correctly read as the preposition H854 with, not the marker.
unto this day writes no the, so both articles are unrepresented and the demonstrative morpheme takes this — the הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה case of rule 29 rather than rule 41's substituted determiner.
